fee_notes: Base Franchise Fee is $59,900 plus $175 per 1,000 people over 250,000 in the Market Territory. Most territories have 250,000–275,000 people, resulting in fees of $59,900–$64,275. In the last fiscal year, a reduced fee of $40,000 was charged to an existing franchisee purchasing additional Market Territories. Multi-unit discount: $49,900 for second franchise, $39,900 for third or subsequent franchise (each plus population-based add-on). Veterans discount: $7,000 off the Franchise Fee for first unit only. Discounts may not be combined.
raw_excerpt: The amount of the Franchise Fee is $59,900, plus an additional $175 per 1,000 people over 250,000 in your Market Territory. Most Market Territories have between 250,000 and 275,000 people, resulting in Franchise Fees ranging from $59,900 to $64,275. The Franchise Fee is deemed fully earned when paid and is non-refundable under any circumstances. In the last fiscal year, we charged a reduced Franchise Fee of $40,000 to an existing franchisee purchasing additional Market Territories.
